summary: Cold iteration 1 for the LRE case study: 15 Java files written from the specification alone, all 51 requirements traced. Seven items need human review, the load-bearing one being the LRE-DM5 / LRE-OP5 conflict over the no-obstacle default for the relative-distance accessors.

issues.title: LRE-DM5 and LRE-OP5 disagree on the no-obstacle default for nsRelDist/ewRelDist
issues.raw: LRE-DM5: 'field accessors nsRelDist, ewRelDist, obsNsVel, and obsEwVel return zero' when no obstacle exists. LRE-OP5: 'The no-dynamic-obstacle case is handled by the Sensor layer, which returns zero-velocity and large-distance defaults when no dynamic obstacle exists.' Returning zero for the two RELATIVE DISTANCE accessors models a phantom obstacle at the AUV's own position, which drives cda to 0 and fires a spurious MOM->CAM transition (LRE-Beh8) whenever no dynamic obstacle exists.
issues.fix_directive: Resolved in favour of LRE-OP5 for the two distance accessors: Sensor.nsRelDist/ewRelDist return NO_OBSTACLE_DISTANCE (1000.0 m) for an unknown index, while Sensor.obsNsVel/obsEwVel return 0.0 per LRE-DM5. Confirm this reading, or amend LRE-DM5 to scope 'return zero' to the velocity accessors.

issues.title: CPA formulas and their safe defaults are not specified
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 names cda and tcpa and says they are computed from the closest dynamic obstacle's relative position and velocity, but gives no formula (unlike LRE-SF1..SF3). The standard closest-point-of-approach formulas were used: tcpa = -(r.v)/|v|^2 and cda = |r + v*tcpa|, over the horizontal plane only (obs_roc and rate_of_climb are not part of the CPA). The division is undefined when the relative speed is zero.
issues.fix_directive: Added Sensor.relSpeedSq(index), which floors the squared relative speed at 1.0e-6 so CalcCPA.compute() stays a total straight-line expression with no conditional (the compute() body rule forbids branching). Confirm the horizontal-plane-only CPA and the floor value.

issues.title: HCM advised velocity: system_description says 0.1 m/s, LRE-FR3 says 0 m/s
issues.raw: system_description.txt: 'HCM (High Caution Mode): Reduced speed (0.1 m/s)'. LRE-FR3: 'On entering HCM, the LRE advises a velocity of 0 m/s'.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented LRE-FR3 (advVel(0.0)) because requirement_all.json is the canonical source. If 0.1 m/s is intended, amend LRE-FR3.

issues.title: Branch order inside MOM chosen so hand-negated guards stay satisfiable
issues.raw: LRE-Beh9/Beh10/Beh11 are three separate MOM->HCM transitions (LRE-DC1 forbids merging them). Each lower-priority branch textually carries the negation of every preceding triggerless guard. Ordering Beh10 (vdist <= staticObsDfltVertDist) before Beh11 (vvel >= 1 and vdist <= staticObsVertDist) would leave Beh11 with 'not (vdist <= staticObsDfltVertDist) and vdist <= staticObsVertDist', which is unsatisfiable when the two thresholds share a value (both default to 1).
issues.fix_directive: Order inside MOM is Beh9, then Beh11, then Beh10. No requirement states a priority among the three, so the order is free; confirm it is acceptable.

issues.title: Event-triggered branches placed before autonomous ones in every mode block
issues.raw: java_codegen_rules.txt requires operator overrides to be the first inner branches, while the preflight rule8 directive prefers triggerless branches first. The two cannot both be satisfied; the codegen rule was followed.
issues.fix_directive: Expect rule8_event_branch_precedes_triggerless warnings from preflight. They are advisory (preflight fails on errors only). Every affected pair (reqOCM vs inOpez in MOM/HCM, reqOCM vs camClear in CAM) targets the same mode OCM, so the divergence is observationally inert except for the advVel(0) on LRE-Beh18.

issues.title: cstc/cdyn keep the -1 sentinel the requirements mandate, despite the int -> nat mapping
issues.raw: LRE-Var5/Var6 define -1 as 'no obstacle exists'. CLAUDE.md records that the M2M maps Java int to RoboChart nat unconditionally, so -1 leaves the formal type's domain.
issues.fix_directive: The sentinel never reaches a controller guard: the Sensor returns safe defaults for an out-of-range index, so no predicate compares cstc or cdyn against -1 and no negative literal appears in the controller. The extracted model therefore under-approximates only the index value, not the behaviour.

issues.title: LRE-FR4 does not say what CAM actually does
issues.raw: LRE-FR4: 'In CAM ... the AUV performs evasive manoeuvres.' LRE-DM7 restricts the LRE's outputs to advVel and advHdng, but no requirement says which values CAM issues, and no LRE-Beh transition into CAM carries an action.
issues.fix_directive: No entry action was emitted for CAM — inventing an evasive heading would be unverifiable behaviour nobody specified. Supply the CAM entry action if one is intended.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> T2M -> M2M -> M2T -> verifiers) and feed failures back via /fix-from-feedback.
